svg.aria-label: The confidence ceiling. Confidence is not what the model says it is. Each evidence class carries a deterministic ceiling computed before the model is asked, and the final confidence is the lower of the model's estimate and that ceiling, so the model can only lower it. The ceilings are: image pull with the registry error in the event, 0.95; OOM killed while running with limits present, 0.90; OOM killed during init where the runtime message or an event names memory, 0.80; CrashLoopBackOff whose previous logs contain a fatal line, 0.80; CrashLoopBackOff whose logs are present but name nothing, 0.40; and CrashLoopBackOff with no logs at all, 0.15, which is routed to abstention before any model call. Below the 0.50 threshold no approve affordance is rendered at all.
svg.title: Confidence is a ceiling the model may only lower
svg.text: The ceiling is computed from the evidence before the model is asked. A model that is sure of itself does not move it.
image pull, registry error in event
OOM killed while running, limits present
crash loop, fatal line in the logs
crash loop, logs that name nothing
crash loop, no logs at all
below this there is no approve affordance at all
The two lightest rows are the ones section 2.3 predicts worst, and
the bottom one never reaches the model: the gate abstains first.
Measured over 31 runs on the same four contracts, the model's own
number never fell below a ceiling. The ceiling is the measurement.
